en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet village or small‑town scene with a narrow canal or stream in the foreground, lined by tall leafless or early‑spring trees and wooden fences. Traditional European houses with steep, tiled roofs stand on the opposite bank along a small road. The water reflects the trees and buildings, giving a tranquil, pastoral atmosphere. At the bottom edge, there appears to be a hand‑written caption on the negative.
